text:
elaine: quick sync — running a tiny field-test for our competitive hooks this week. goal: finalize 3 battlecard claim frames vs cloud AI + 2 webinar headline variants, and validate what drives inbound signups.

sam: SGTM. do we have a short list of claims to A/B?

elaine: yup — rough list in thread below. thinking: 1) "Serving-first economics" (latency + cost control), 2) "Unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private" (portability), 3) "Operational fallbacks & predictable SLOs" (reliability).

maria: love the 3. can we make the wording more customer-facing? e.g., "Save 30–60% on serving costs" is provocative but need backup.

raj: put a small benchmark snapshot in the battlecard for Q3 webinar — 95th p99 latency numbers and cost per token examples. even if ranges.

elaine: agreed. i'll add a short table in the doc: latency p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost/token estimate. keep it non-specific: "typical customers see 2–3x lower token costs with batching + caching".

nick: i can mock 2 hero slides for the webinar headlines — need final headline by Thu EOD.

sam: who owns the routing copy? want to test two CTA flows: "Try demo" vs "Request dedicated" — see which pulls more enterprise leads.

maria: i'll wire the demo funnel copy. propose: demo CTA for PLG leads, "Request dedicated" surfaces a short form with enterprise checklist.

elaine: @sam @maria perfect. ops-bot: can we spin up two landing routes with UTM tags for the webinar?

ops-bot: deploy task created: ENG-landing-4298. Route variants: /webinar-demo?utm=hero and /webinar-enterprise?utm=hero. Estimated deploy Wed morning.

raj: for the field-test, can we run a short paid LinkedIn creative: 1) econ-led (cost/latency), 2) reliability-led (SLOs/fallbacks). measure CTR->signup.

sam: i'll budget a modest test ($1k) and monitor. timeline: ads run Thu–Mon, check Monday morning results.

maria: also capturing lead source in the form (checkbox: exploring infra vs exploring hosted API) — helps segmentation.

elaine: perfect. deliverables: nick slides by Thu, landing routes by Wed AM, ad creatives by Wed EOD, battlecard draft with benchmark snippets by Thu. i'll do a quick playbook for SDRs to respond to demo vs enterprise signups.

sam: quick Q — how tight do we want claims vs "cloud AI" specifically vs more generic "managed endpoints"?

elaine: prefer both. primary copy calls out cloud AI competitors for field-level hooks, but battlecard has modular phrasing so SDRs can swap to "managed endpoints" claims for less technical buyers.

maria: will draft two short rebut lines for each claim: cost, portability, reliability. keep <2 sentences each.

raj: logging note: include a small note on model parity — "we match open model quality; our advantage is serving economics". avoids promising accuracy delta.

elaine: good call. one-liners only. thanks team — will post battlecard draft in #marketing tomorrow for a fast review. :rocket:

nick: cheers — will ping when slides are up.

sam: adding calendar block for Mon review. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: ENG-landing-4298 deploy check Wed 09:30 UTC."
